ad_intro:
Duroflex (duroflexworld.com) is a Sleep/Mattress brand running ~40 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.1-2 Cr/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Legacy mattress + sleep brand known for Duropedic.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: celebrity-led, customer-story ugc low - The gap: unboxing / sleep-story UGC. (2) Landing page: a celebrity-led page with no customer sleep-story proof. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Enterprise lead in active scaling/cost mode - pitch efficiency and CVR, not more spend.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
~40 ads + Rs.1-2 Cr/mo = consistent mid-tier spender.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Celebrity-led, customer-story UGC low. The gap: unboxing / sleep-story UGC.
Copy leak: Current angle is celebrity-led. Missing angle: sleep-quality outcome over celebrity.
Landing page leak: A celebrity-led page with no customer sleep-story proof.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy unboxing / sleep-story UGC
Shoot 15 fifteen-second unboxing / sleep-story UGC and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add customer sleep-story + unboxing UGC on PDPs. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
